page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2ne.6xlarge is a general-purpose instance powered by the KVM hypervisor and an x86_64 architecture. It features 24 dedicated vCPUs derived from 12 physical Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 cores running at 2.5 GHz, with hyper-threading enabled. The instance is equipped with 96.0 GB of system memory, translating to 4.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPUs, and it provides a baseline network bandwidth of 4 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates a clear division between single-core and multi-core performance. Single-core metrics, such as stress-ng single-core CPU performance and Geekbench single-core scores, fall into the weak category, with single-threaded gzip compression performing poorly. However, the instance leverages its 24 vCPUs to achieve average performance in multi-core benchmarks, including stress-ng multi-core, Geekbench multi-core, and Passmark CPU tests. Memory bandwidth for both small and large blocks also registers in the average tier.

Given its balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and dedicated CPU allocation, the ecs.sn2ne.6xlarge is suited for multi-threaded workloads that do not require high single-core clock speeds. Appropriate workloads include static web serving, database operations, software compilation, and moderate multi-threaded decompression tasks, all of which achieved average tier results in benchmarks. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the instance offers a stable, non-burstable resource profile for general-purpose enterprise applications, though workloads requiring local NVMe storage or high-speed single-threaded execution will face performance tradeoffs.
